description: This file defines a React component named 'HistoryPanel' which displays a user's recent game history in a Tic-Tac-Toe platform. It fetches data from an API endpoint, handles loading/error states, and renders a list of game summaries with formatted dates.

methods.name: HistoryPanel
methods.description: React component that renders the game history panel, fetching data using SWR and displaying game summaries.
